### Ready to get started?

If you’re not using an ecommerce platform today, find out how to sign up for one by checking out the [BigCommerce](https://www.bigcommerce.com/), [PrestaShop](https://www.prestashop.com/en/), or [Magento](https://www.magentocommerce.com/) website. If you’re already using one of these platforms, visit our [Help Center](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6279293) or the [BigCommerce](http://bigcommerce.com/google-shopping), [PrestaShop](http://addons.prestashop.com/en/23831-google-shopping.html), and [Magento](https://www.magentocommerce.com/magento-connect/google-shopping-1.html?_ga=1.87497947.239216604.1476690424) help pages to learn more.
